simple.meaning: חָזוֹן (châzôwn) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a sight (mentally), i.e. a dream , revelation , or oracle.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Samuel 3:1. The surrounding context includes family line, kingship, prophetic witness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָזוֹן (H2377) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H2377. chazon חָזוֺן noun masculine Dan 8:1 vision (on formation compare Lg BN 204 ) — absolute ׳ח Hosea 12:11 25t.; construct חֲזוֺן Isa 1:1 8 t. 1 vision , as seen in the ecstatic state || קסם Micah 3:6 ; || מקסם Ezek 12:24 ; || חלמות Dan 1:17 ; || נביא 9:24 ; ח ׳חזה Ezek 12:27 ; 13:16 ; ח ׳ראה Dan 8:15 ; בח ׳ראה 8:2 (twice in verse); 9:21 ; בח ׳דבּר Psa 89:20 ; אל נראה חזון Dan 8:1 vision appeared unto ; מיהוה ח ׳מצא Lam 2:9 find a vision from Yahweh ; also Ezek 12:22-23 , Dan 8:13 , 17 , 26 ; 10:14 ; 11:14 . 2 vision , in the night לַיְלָה חֲזוֺן Isa 29:7 . 3 divine communication in a vision, oracle, prophecy מנביא ח ׳בקשׁ seek a vision (prophecy) from prophet Ezek 7:26 ; || (יםׅ דבר 1Sam 3:1 ; 1Chr 17:15 ; יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ לִבָּם חֲזוֺן Jer 23:16 a prophecy of their own hearts (minds) they speak; מִתְנַבְּאִים הֵמָּה לִבָּם וְתַרְמִית אֱלִיל וְקֶסֶם שֶׁקֶר חֲזוֺן 14:14 FALSE vision and (see אֱלִיל ) worthless divination & deceit of their own hearts they are prophesying ; ח ׳כתב write the vision Hab 2:2 ; also Hosea 12:11 ; Hab 2:3 ; Prov 29:18 ; Ezek 7:13 (strike out Co). 4 vision , as title of book of prophecy, נחוּם חזון ספר Nahum 1:1 ; ׳ח ישׁעיהו Isa 1:1 ; ׳ח עבדיה Obadiah; of other writings of prophets 2Chr 32:32 .
